name: Ergothioneine
summary: Ergothioneine is a diet-derived sulfur-containing amino-acid derivative concentrated in some mushrooms and transported in humans by OCTN1. A small randomized pilot trial in older adults with mild cognitive impairment reported signals in learning performance and neurofilament-light trajectories, but the human cognition evidence remains preliminary.
description: Canonical ergothioneine entity for evidence and safety integration. Publication remains held until the small human cognition literature, dietary-versus-isolated exposure boundary, biomarkers, longer-term safety, and replication status have passed the site’s review gates.
primary_effects_or_targets: antioxidant redox activity; OCTN1 transport; neuroprotection research
